verdict.rationale: Mailgun's docs explicitly describe 'Route Management' for defining rules to forward or store incoming email, and inbound parsing that routes messages to an application (POST) [mailgun-docs-6, mailgun-docs-33, mailgun-docs-26, mailgun-docs-5]. Community testimony independently corroborates strong rule-based inbound handling, calling it 'the best inbound handling... in terms of letting you apply rules before the messages hit your servers' [mailgun-comm-8], and another user confirms using inbound routing to forward mail for years [mailgun-comm-3]. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recipient-pattern/regex matching syntax and a worked example showing multiple endpoints (forward vs store vs POST) selected per rule.
